//go:build js && wasm

package client

import (
	"syscall/js"
)

// Offline operations share the one framework checked native primitive. Keep
// offline receipt/decoder policy here; never introduce a second reflection
// capture or implicit recursive Go ValueOf conversion for composites.

func offlineJSGet(value js.Value, property string) js.Value {
	return checkedJSGet(value, property)
}

func offlineJSSet(value js.Value, property string, next any) {
	checkedJSSet(value, property, next)
}

func offlineJSIndex(value js.Value, index int) js.Value {
	return checkedJSIndex(value, index)
}

func offlineJSLength(value js.Value) int {
	return checkedJSLength(value)
}

func offlineJSCall(value js.Value, method string, args ...any) js.Value {
	return checkedJSCall(value, method, args...)
}

func offlineJSInvoke(function js.Value, args ...any) js.Value { return checkedJSInvoke(function, args...) }
func offlineJSNew(function js.Value, args ...any) js.Value { return checkedJSNew(function, args...) }
func offlineJSArray(values []any) js.Value { return checkedJSArray(values) }
func offlineJSObject(values map[string]any) js.Value { return checkedJSObject(values) }
func offlineJSApply(function, receiver, arguments js.Value) js.Value { return checkedJSApply(function, receiver, arguments) }

func offlineJSRequest(request offlineRequest) js.Value {
	return offlineJSObject(map[string]any{
		"version": request.Version, "command": request.Command,
		"ownerPolicyID": request.OwnerPolicyID, "runtimeID": request.RuntimeID,
		"configurationID": request.ConfigurationID, "requestID": request.RequestID,
	})
}

// Legacy read-only/ordinary reply callbacks have no caller-stack recovery: a
// callback runs on its own Go event goroutine. Decode the event property within
// its own recovery boundary too. Fresh Disable additionally retains its owned
// listener/charge until a later valid exact native reply.
func decodeOfflineEvent(args []js.Value, request offlineRequest) (reply offlineReply, err error) {
	defer func() {
		if recover() != nil {
			reply, err = offlineReply{}, ErrOfflineProtocol
		}
	}()
	if len(args) != 1 {
		return reply, ErrOfflineProtocol
	}
	return decodeOfflineMessage(offlineJSGet(args[0], "data"), request)
}
